MRT.note: No authentication service, e-signature or PKI is stated.
No exchange of records between civil register and ID system is stated.
Only refugees registered (about 185,000) are counted, not the population enrolled.
Birth certificates are mentioned for refugee children; no number at birth is stated.
Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: UNHCR says registered refugees in Hodh Chargui receive a National Identification Number, enabling access to essential services with ANRPTS.
